frames.description: The 3table editor just opened: a dark 3D grid with the File menu showing Import and Export options (OBJ, STL, 3MF).
Early assembly in 3table: a green PCB modelled next to a green component on a grey base, with the parts/properties table open on the left.
An open grey case shell on the grid with a green tab inside and a green clip on the front face; properties table open.
The long grey rectangular case body on the grid, one end open showing an orange interior accent.
An 'Add Part' dialog over the open grey case, with a green PCB visible inside the shell.
Inside the open case: two green circuit boards mounted on posts with a red divider, seen from above; properties table open.
Interior of the case showing a green board and bracket held on threaded posts.
Overhead view into the open case: green boards and threaded mounting posts inside.
The finished closed grey case: a long box with a small green power switch on the front face.
Exploded view: the grey case body and its dark lid floating apart on the grid.
Cockpit POV on a real race track: a hand holds the 3D-printed controller (carbon-look shell with a fan vent) up to the camera; the Renault Sport dash shows neutral and a RaceLogic timer.
Track POV with the controller held near the roll cage; dash in neutral; grandstands and cars ahead.
Driving shot: the controller held to the left, cars ahead including a green Clio; pit building on the right.
On-track POV in traffic (green Clio, white cars) with the controller at the left edge.
Following cars down the straight; controller in hand; RaceLogic timer reads 0:10; dash in 3rd gear.
Straight/corner approach, RaceLogic 0:12, 3rd gear, cars ahead.
Turning into a corner, RaceLogic 0:16, 2nd gear, a green car ahead.
Mid-corner with the controller and wheel in view, RaceLogic 0:20, gravel trap beside the track.
Corner exit, RaceLogic 0:22, controller held, track curving right.
Close-up of the controller in hand against the Renault Sport dash, 1st gear.
